result.rationale: The platform is now Arium Networks. Crown Castle exited on 2026-05-01; EQT lists Arium under EQT Active Core Infrastructure I. Zayo's Fiber Solutions deal is separate.

aliases: Crown Castle Small Cell & Venue business
identityResolution.conclusion: Correct in place: Arium Networks is the display name; Crown Castle names are predecessor aliases; Small Cells HoldCo is the acquisition holdco.

ownershipResolution.control: EQT affiliates manage the structure; Small Cells GP LLC was charted as GP with deemed 100% voting/0% equity, subject to final documents. The AIFM holds no depicted equity.
ownershipResolution.coInvestors: TopCo economics: passive 9.03%; H.E.S.T. 15.65%; EQT ACI Co-Investment H 21.67%; Co-Investment I 29.68%; Small Cells Aggregator 23.96%. Whitecap/Temasek owns 83.33% of H; NPS Korea and GIC own 60.85% and 30.43% of I.
ownershipResolution.stakeConclusion: EQT's percentage is not disclosed because fund/sidecar interests are nested.

operatingResolution.launch: Arium brand announced December 2025; standalone launch 2026-05-01.
operatingResolution.business: Outdoor small cells, DAS and in-building/venue networks; turnkey deployment and management.
operatingResolution.customersAndScale: Top three U.S. mobile network operators; 100,000+ small cells on air or under contract across 43 states at launch.
operatingResolution.boundary: Crown Castle Fiber LLC retained small cells after fiber assets moved to Fiber NewCo/Fiber AssetCo. Zayo bought Fiber Solutions separately and supplies Arium under a long-term agreement.

acquisitionExitCheck.laterFinding: No public later sale, owner transfer, merger, asset sale, recapitalization, refinancing or signed pending deal was found; EQT still lists Arium as current.
acquisitionExitCheck.financingFinding: A 2026-02-26 filing described close-related secured debt/guarantees and possible notes or credit facilities. Amount, lenders and terms are NOT_PUBLICLY_DISCLOSED; no later refinancing was found.

milestones.event: EQT Active Core signed to acquire Small Cells Solutions for about $4.25 billion; Zayo's fiber purchase was separate.
Arium Networks announced as successor brand.
Sale to Small Cells HoldCo Inc., referred to as Arium Networks, closed; Arium launched.
